title: MG-04 re-judgment: prior vs learned candidates (MaMe-Re, frozen v2.1 conditions, enlarged test denominator)

conditions.split: v2.1 frozen 30 train / 20 validation / 200 test contexts (data/mame_fixed_context_splits_v21.json)
conditions.training_data: 30 v2.1 train contexts only (CC BY 4.0 columns); no test/validation labels used for fitting; alpha selected on v2.1 validation only
conditions.validation_construction: both pair modes per validation context (20 contexts x 2 modes = 40 cases)
conditions.test_construction: 1 case per test context, identical construction to canon build_cases (Random(SEED) sample order, mode by index parity)
conditions.comparability: v2.1 numbers are a NEW version and are NOT comparable to v2.0/v1 numbers (different split, train size and case set); v1 remains frozen
